Pinout: p.1 Terminal Assignment (24-pin, M = SOIC). OEAB active high, OEBA active low, SAB/SBA low = real-time, high = stored; CAB/CBA rising edge stores (function table p.2, '652 column). Timing p.4 (AC) and p.5 (ACT); ROC p.2.

ACT.note: max tPLH/tPHL store A data to B bus (clock->B), 5 V, -40 to 85 C, 50 pF; no typical in the table (cd74act652 p.5). VCC 4.5-5.5 V (cd74act652 p.2)

devices.description: 8-bit registered transceiver, real-time or stored data, 3-state outputs (FCT pin names)
devices.note: Separate from 74_652 because cy74fct652t prints different control names (CPAB/CPBA clocks, GAB/GBA enables). Pinout: cy74fct652t p.1 (Q = QSOP/DBQ, SO = SOIC/DW). GAB active high, GBA active low, SAB/SBA low = real-time, high = stored; CPAB/CPBA rising edge stores regardless of select/enable (function table p.2). Speed grades T/AT/CT share one FCT entry (base T numbers).

FCT.note: max tPLH/tPHL CPAB/CPBA->B/A, CY74FCT652T grade, -40 to 85 C; no typical printed (AT 6.3, CT 5.7) (cy74fct652t p.7). VCC 4.75-5.25 V (cy74fct652t p.5)

devices.description: Octal bus transceiver and registers, real-time or stored data, 3-state outputs (LS pin names)
devices.note: Separate from 74_652 only because the LS datasheet prints different control names (CAB/CBA clocks, GAB/GBA enables). Pinout: sn74ls652 p.1 (scanned; JT/DW/NT top view): pin 22 is printed 'SA' in the pinout drawings but SBA in the logic diagram/symbol (p.3-4), named SBA here. GAB active high, GBA active low, SAB/SBA low = real-time, high = stored, CAB/CBA rising edge stores regardless of select/enable (function table p.2, 'LS652 column). Timing p.6, ROC p.5.

LS.note: typ tPLH/tPHL clock->bus at 5 V, 25 C, 45 pF, RL 667 ohm, 'LS652 (sn74ls652 p.6). VCC 4.75-5.25 V (SN74LS652, sn74ls652 p.5)

devices.description: Octal bus transceiver and register, inverting, open-collector A outputs, 3-state B outputs
devices.note: sn74als653 = sn54als653 (SDAS066G). Pinout p.1 (JT, DW/NT; W not drawn, assumed = JT). Function table p.4 ('ALS653 table); A outputs open-collector, B outputs 3-state (p.1 device table); inverting data paths. Timing p.15, ROC p.12. The model takes one output style per device: A side is really open-collector, B side 3-state (see _report.md).

ALS.note: max tPLH/tPHL CLKAB->B, SN74ALS653, 4.5-5.5 V, 50 pF, no typ printed (sn74als653 p.15); A->B real time max 18/15, CLKBA->A (open-collector) max 64/22; VCC 4.5-5.5 V SN54 and SN74 (p.12)

devices.description: 8-bit dual-supply bus transceiver / level shifter, 3-state outputs
devices.note: Pinout sn74avc8t245 p.3 Pin Functions (DGV, PW, RHL); sn74avc8t245-q1 p.3 (PW, RHL figures); sn74avch8t245 p.3; sn74lvc8t245 p.3 (DB, DW, NS, PW); sn74lvch8t245 p.3 (DB, DGV, PW, RHL); sn74lxc8t245 p.3 (PW, DGS, RHL numbering; RJW differs, not used); sn74lxc8t245-q1 p.3; sn74lxch8t245 p.3 - all the same 24-pin assignment. DIR high = A to B, OE low enables (sn74lxc8t245 p.22 function table; same in the others). DIR and OE referenced to VCCA. Bus hold (AVCH, LVCH, LXCH) not modeled.

AVC.note: max tPLH/tPHL A->B at VCCA 3.3 V, VCCB 3.3 V (nearest row to 3.3<->5 V; device max 3.6 V), -40 to 85 C (sn74avc8t245 p.10, no typ printed); VCCA/VCCB 1.2-3.6 V, VI to 3.6 V (p.5)

LVC.note: max tPLH/tPHL A->B at VCCA 3.3 V, VCCB 5 V (sn74lvc8t245 p.11, no typ printed); VCCA/VCCB 1.65-5.5 V, control VI to 5.5 V (p.7)

LXC.note: max tpd A->B at VCCA 3.3 V, VCCB 5 V, -40 to 85 C (sn74lxc8t245 p.13, no typ printed); VCCA/VCCB 1.08-5.5 V, VI to 5.5 V (p.5)

devices.description: 1-bit fixed-direction dual-supply level translator, Schmitt-trigger input, 3-state output
devices.note: Pinout txu0101 p.3 (DBV, DCK, DRY, DTQ all the same): VCCA 1, GND 2, A 3, BY 4, OE 5, VCCB 6; txu0101-q1 p.3 same (DCK, DRY). A -> BY when OE high, OE low = BY Z (p.1, p.3). A referenced to VCCA, BY to VCCB; OE works from either supply (VCC(MIN) logic), put in the VCCA domain. Inputs have weak pull-downs (not modeled).

TXU.note: max tpd A->B at VCCA 3.3 V +-0.3 V, VCCB 5 V +-0.5 V, -40 to 85 C (txu0101 p.13; no typical printed); VCCA and VCCB 1.08-5.5 V, VI 0-5.5 V on every input (p.5); -q1 p.5 same

devices.description: Dual-bit fixed-direction voltage-level translator, Schmitt-trigger inputs, 3-state outputs
devices.note: Pinout: txu0102 p.4 Figures 6-1..6-3 + Table 6-1 (DCU, DTT, DTM: same numbering); txu0102-q1 p.3 (DCU, DTT, same). Both bits A->B (A1->B1Y, A2->B2Y); OE high enables, low = all outputs Hi-Z (function table txu0102 p.23). OE may be driven from either VCCA or VCCB logic levels (VCC(MIN) circuitry); placed in the VCCA domain. Inputs and OE have weak internal pull-downs.

TXU.note: max tpd A->B at VCCA 3.3 V, VCCB 5.0 V, -40 to 85 C; no typical printed (txu0102 p.14). VCCA and VCCB 1.08-5.5 V, VI 0-5.5 V (txu0102 p.6; txu0102-q1 same)

devices.description: 4-bit fixed-direction (A to B) dual-supply level shifter, Schmitt-trigger inputs, 3-state outputs
devices.note: Pinout from txu0104-q1 p.4 (PW; WBQA same numbering). Function table (txu0104-q1 p.24): OE H -> outputs follow inputs, OE L -> Hi-Z. OE may be driven from either supply's levels (datasheet: VCC(MIN) control logic); placed in the VCCA domain. Inputs have static pull-downs (not modeled).

TXU.note: Max tpd A->B at VCCA 3.3 V, VCCB 5 V, -40 to 85 C (txu0104-q1 p.14). VCCA/VCCB 1.08-5.5 V, VI 0-5.5 V (txu0104-q1 p.6)

devices.description: Dual-bit fixed-direction level shifter (one A to B, one B to A), Schmitt inputs, 3-state
devices.note: Pinout from txu0202 p.4 (DCU, DTT; DTM not in this group) and txu0202-q1 p.3 (same): B2 1, GND 2, VCCA 3, A2Y 4, A1 5, OE 6, VCCB 7, B1Y 8. Channel 1 A1 -> B1Y, channel 2 B2 -> A2Y. OE high = enabled, low = all outputs Hi-Z (p.23 function table). OE may be driven from either VCCA or VCCB levels (p.3); put in the VCCA domain.

TXU.note: Max tpd A->B at VCCA = 3.3 V, VCCB = 5 V, -40 to 85 C (B->A 10 ns; no typical) (txu0202 p.14). VCCA/VCCB 1.08-5.5 V, VI to 5.5 V (p.6)

devices.description: 4-bit fixed-direction dual-supply level shifter (2 A-to-B, 2 B-to-A), Schmitt-trigger inputs, 3-state outputs
devices.note: Pinouts txu0204 p.4 Table 6-1 (PW/BQA 14-pin, NC on 6 and 9; RUT/DTR 12-pin), txu0204-q1 p.4 (PW/WBQA same as PW). OE high (to VCCA or VCCB level, VCC(MIN) logic) enables all outputs, low = high impedance (p.1, p.4). A1/A2 -> B1Y/B2Y, B3/B4 -> A3Y/A4Y. OE placed in the VCCA domain (sheet: either supply). Inputs have weak pulldowns (not modeled).

TXU.note: max tpd A->B at VCCA 3.3 V, VCCB 5 V, -40 to 85 C, no typ printed (txu0204 p.14; B->A max 10); VCCA and VCCB 1.08-5.5 V, VI 0-5.5 V (p.6); -Q1 same (txu0204-q1 p.6)

devices.description: 4-bit fixed-direction (3 A to B, 1 B to A) dual-supply level shifter, Schmitt-trigger inputs, 3-state outputs
devices.note: PW pinout and RUT pinout from txu0304 p.4 (Table 6-1: PW/BQA and RUT/DTR columns); txu0304-q1 p.4 PW the same. A1-A3 in (VCCA) -> B1Y-B3Y out (VCCB); B4 in (VCCB) -> A4Y out (VCCA). Function table (txu0304 p.23): OE H -> outputs follow inputs, OE L -> Hi-Z. OE may be driven from either supply's levels; placed in the VCCA domain. Inputs have static pull-downs (not modeled).

TXU.note: Max tpd A->B at VCCA 3.3 V, VCCB 5 V, -40 to 85 C (txu0304 p.14). VCCA/VCCB 1.08-5.5 V, VI 0-5.5 V (txu0304 p.6)

devices.description: 6-bit fixed-direction dual-supply voltage translator, 3-state outputs
devices.note: txv0106 p.3: BQB WQFN-16 pinout 1 VCCA, 2-7 A1-A6, 8 GND, 9 OE, 10-15 B6-B1, 16 VCCB (+ thermal pad, not a pin); A pins and OE referenced to VCCA, B pins to VCCB. Function table p.17: OE low = A data to B bus, OE high = isolation (both ports Hi-Z). Fixed direction A->B. Integrated 10-ohm damping resistor on outputs (not modeled).

TXV.note: max tpd A->B at VCCA 3.3 V, VCCB 3.3 V, 15 pF (txv0106 p.10; no typical printed); VCCA and VCCB 1.14-3.6 V, VI 0-3.6 V (p.5)
